summary: Situated within a popular and well-established residential area of Hartlepool and enjoys a convenient location close to a wide range of local amenities, making it ideally suited to families, first-time buyers and commuters alike.
description:
The property is within easy reach of local schools, supermarkets, convenience stores and everyday amenities, together with nearby parks and recreational facilities offering excellent opportunities for leisure and outdoor activities. Hartlepool town centre and the Marina are also easily accessible, providing a fantastic selection of shops, restaurants, cafés and bars, as well as scenic coastal walks and attractions along the seafront. For commuters, the property benefits from excellent transport links with convenient road access and nearby public transport routes connecting to surrounding towns and cities across the North East. Combining convenience with a welcoming community atmosphere, this location offers an excellent setting for modern day living. This spacious three-bedroom property offers generous accommodation throughout and briefly comprises an entrance hall, lounge, dining room open plan to the kitchen, ground floor bathroom and separate ground floor WC. To the first floor there are three well-proportioned bedrooms, making this an ideal home for families or those seeking versatile living space.

ENTRANCE HALL Accessed via a UPVC framed double glazed entrance door, the entrance hall provides a welcoming introduction to the home and benefits from stairs leading to the first floor accommodation together with a radiator providing warmth and comfort.

LOUNGE A bright and inviting lounge benefitting from a UPVC framed double glazed bay window allowing for an abundance of natural light, creating a warm and airy atmosphere. The room is further enhanced by laminate flooring and a radiator, offering both comfort and practicality for everyday living.

OPEN PLAN DINING ROOOM / KITCHEN A spacious dining room offering an excellent open plan layout ideal for modern family living and entertaining. The dining area benefits from two UPVC framed double glazed windows allowing for plenty of natural light, together with laminate flooring and a radiator creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The room also houses the wall mounted combination gas central heating boiler and flows seamlessly through to the kitchen area. The kitchen is fitted with a range of wall and base units complemented by laminate work surfaces, providing ample storage and preparation space. Features include an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap, plumbing for an automatic washing machine and a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for additional natural light, creating a practical and functional kitchen space.

GROUND FLOOR BATHROOM Fitted with a white suite comprising a panelled bath, wash hand basin and WC, the family bathroom offers a practical and well-maintained space. The room is complemented by part panelled walls providing a clean and stylish finish, together with a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for natural light and ventilation.

GROUND FLOOR WC Fitted with a white WC, the ground floor cloakroom provides useful additional convenience for modern family living. The room also benefits from a radiator and a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for natural light and ventilation.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first floor landing provides access to all bedrooms and benefits from loft access, offering useful additional storage and potential for conversion subject to the necessary planning permissions and building regulations.

BEDROOM ONE A spacious and well-appointed principal bedroom benefitting from a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for plenty of natural light, together with a radiator providing warmth and comfort. The room also features a useful walk-in wardrobe space, offering excellent storage and practicality.

BEDROOM TWO A well-proportioned bedroom benefitting from a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for plenty of natural light, together with a radiator creating a warm and comfortable atmosphere.

BEDROOM THREE A versatile third bedroom benefitting from a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for natural light, together with a radiator providing warmth and comfort. The room would lend itself perfectly as a child's bedroom, guest room or home office.

EXTERNALLY To the front of the property is a wall enclosed forecourt creating an attractive and defined frontage. To the rear is an enclosed courtyard with gated access, providing a private and low maintenance outdoor space ideal for everyday use.
